description: What changed for one surgeon since the rep last touched them (their last logged visit, status change or note; or since a given day, default 90 days): moves and practice changes, partners who joined or left, a new Open Payments year and any change of main company, a new Medicare year with the case change, and new FDA clearances and recalls from the companies engaged with them. With the rep's own record: status per line, recent visits, open follow-ups and notes, inYourBriefs when the rep's written territory brief features them, and inTheNews for this week's local news that touches them. The first half of a pre-call brief; counts as opening the profile.

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default the rep's last touch, or 90 days ago.

name: changes_since
title: What changed since the last visit
